problems.title: Selected inverse entries from a pivoted UMFPACK factorization
problems.summary: A nonsingular sparse matrix can have a zero pivot in an unpivoted LDLᵀ factorization or be unsuitable for Cholesky. UMFPACK can factor these matrices, but upstream SelectedInversion.jl cannot use its factors to compute inverse entries at a requested sparsity pattern.

commits.title: Add selected inversion from pivoted sparse LU (UMFPACK)
Test, document and benchmark LU selected inversion
Check UMFPACK's divide-by-scale case through do_recip
Use plain Documenter references to selinv!

fix.why_together: The first commit adds the pivoted LU recurrence, row scaling and workspace. The next three supply its tests, documentation and benchmark, correct the divide-by-scale regression test, and repair the documentation links. These four commits can be applied without the KLU extension.

problems.title: Selected inverse entries from KLU block triangular factors
problems.summary: Callers with an existing KLU factorization cannot request selected inverse entries upstream. Coupled blocks contribute an off-diagonal term, and KLU expresses its row scales in permuted order. Both affect the returned entries.

commits.title: Support KLU factorizations in LU selected inversion

fix.why_together: One commit adds the KLU extension and regression tests. It shares the UMFPACK factor buffers and folds off-diagonal block coupling into the upper factor so both solvers can use the same selected-inversion recurrence.

requires.name: KLU.jl 0.6
requires.why: Loading KLU.jl enables the package extension that reads KLU factors. The UMFPACK methods can be used independently.
